data.one_liner: Detect taps outside the currently defined widget and provide a callback.
data.what_it_does: TapCanvas allows defining an area on the screen and detecting taps that occur outside of specific child widgets. It provides callbacks when taps occur both inside and outside the defined widgets.
use_when: Legacy applications using old Flutter versions that lack TapRegion
avoid_when: New applications, as the package is deprecated and superseded by Flutter's built-in TapRegion
Modern projects where standard Material or Cupertino text fields already handle outside taps automatically
strengths: Simple API for outside tap detection
weaknesses: No longer maintained and officially deprecated
Rendered pointless by Flutter framework's TapRegion
